title: Makani M600 land crosswind playbook (nominal loop schedules) and the constants of the nominal-loop attitude law

provenance.corrections: 2026-10-07: dalpha_dairspeed_rad_per_m_s was -0.009308422677494552, wrong from the 11th significant digit; it is now the double of -deg2rad(8.0/15.0), as config/m600/control/crosswind.py line 277 computes it (found by the check L3 of the controller-library trial against the library's parameters; relative change 2.06e-11).
provenance.playbook_rows: config/m600/control/crosswind_playbook.py, the land set (the `else` branch of GetPlaybook, lines 161-281): `playbook_parameterized` lines 218-281, one row per wind speed; `wind_adjust_params` lines 162-166; `smoothing_params` lines 175-213. The offshore set (kTestSiteNorway, lines 21-159) is not used (G4 contract, revision of 2026-10-02 22:23).
provenance.transout_airspeeds: lines 295-303 of the same file; they belong to the transition-out schedule and are not used by the nominal loop (kept here so that the smoothing input is complete).
provenance.table_construction: config/m600/control/crosswind_playbook_utils.py: GeneratePeriodicSplineLookupTable (periodic cubic spline through the control points placed at the centres of equal segments of the loop, FBL convention; sampled at CROSSWIND_SCHEDULE_TABLE_LENGTH = 50 points of the controller loop angle through x -> (-x + 1.5 pi)/(2 pi); last point set equal to the first), ConvolveSmooth and SmoothPlaybook (smoothing across the wind-speed rows and along the loop angle with the weights below), MakePlaybook (_AdjustWindSpeed: adjusted = max(wind + min_offset, crossover + (wind - crossover) * scaling_factor)); control/crosswind/crosswind_playbook_types.h (table length 50). The controller interpolates the tables linearly in loop angle (common/c_math/util.c CircularInterp1) and linearly between the two bracketing wind-speed rows (control/crosswind/crosswind_playbook.c GetNominalPlaybookEntry, CrossfadePlaybookEntries).
provenance.attitude_law: control/crosswind/crosswind_util.c (CalcCircularLoopGeometry, CalcCrosswindKinematics, CalcCircularLoopKinematics, CalcCrosswindAttitude, CalcCrosswindPqr, CurvatureToTetherRoll), control/crosswind/crosswind_frame.c (CalcDcmGToCw, CalcDcmFToG, CalcDcmFToB), control/crosswind/crosswind_path.c (CalcGravityCurvature, CalcApparentWindCurvature, RemoveCurvatureCorrections), control/crosswind/crosswind_curvature.c (alpha crossfade with airspeed, tether roll command = CurvatureToTetherRoll + feed-forward, saturation to tether_roll_nom +- excursion(tension)), control/crosswind/crosswind_power.c (SetAirspeed with the saturation to [min_airspeed, max_airspeed], GetAirspeedDerivative with the table spacing as the difference step, path centre SphToVecG(azimuth, elevation, tether length)), control/ground_frame.c (SphToVecG negates the elevation: g is north-east-down), common/c_math/geometry.c (AngleToDcm, SphToCart), control/simple_aero.c (AlphaToCL, BetaToCY).
provenance.constants: config/m600/control/crosswind.py lines 140, 143 (min/max airspeed), 212 (loop direction clockwise), 276-278 (alpha fade), 291-302 (tether roll excursions, tensions, nominal roll, feed-forward), 307-312 (command saturations), 321 (kp_tension_hf = 0: the tension-based dCL command is switched off); config/m600/control/simple_aero_model.py lines 29-37; config/m600/wing.py lines 135 (serial 06 crosswind mass 1667.9 + 51.5 + 10.6 + 0.6 kg), 179-186 (bridle positions, radius 4.7860 m, y offset -0.5 m), 194 (reference area 32.9 m2); config/m600/tether.py lines 29, 38 (length 425.8 m, linear density 0.917 kg/m); config/common/physical_constants.py lines 45, 84 (Parker Ranch air density 1.026 kg/m3, g 9.81 m/s2).
provenance.not_transcribed: the rate limits of the alpha and beta commands (RateLimit, stateful; the schedules below change slower than the limits, which the receipts check), the fade-in of the tether roll after transition-in, the trans-out branches, the tension high-pass dCL command (gain 0), the fallback playbook, the azimuth limits of the test site, the slewing of the path centre and the path controller (k_tab, costs, low-pass filters, the clamp to k_aero_curr +- max_k_aero_error): the nominal loop uses the geometric curvature -1/radius with the gravity and apparent-wind corrections removed, which is the author's steady-state substitute for the path controller's command. Measured quantities the controller uses are replaced by the commanded ones: the airspeed in the alpha fade, the tether roll in the attitude (the controller uses the measured roll with the command only in the roll loop), the tension in the roll saturation band (declared). CalcCrosswindPqr is reproduced as a stencil on the law only (see the module).

controller_constants.loop_direction: clockwise seen from the ground station (kLoopDirectionCw, loop angle decreasing in flight)
controller_constants.airspeed_derivative: central difference of the saturated table look-up with the table spacing 2 pi / 49 as the step (GetAirspeedDerivative)
controller_constants.pqr: central difference of the attitude at loop angle +- 1e-3 rad (CalcCrosswindPqr)

system_constants.wing_mass_note: serial 06 crosswind: kite 1667.9 + bridles 51.5 + wing-side termination 10.6 + GoPros 0.6
system_constants.air_density_note: Parker Ranch (land site); the OpenFAWE runs use the density of their wake configuration and record both
